Coca Cola Co (KO) Shareholder Chatham Capital Group Has Lowered Its Position; As Avis Budget Group (CAR) Stock Rose, Verition Fund Management Lowered by $1.19 Million Its Position
May 16, 2018 - By Hazel Jackson
Chatham Capital Group Inc decreased its stake in Coca Cola Co (KO) by 12.12% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Chatham Capital Group Inc sold 10,648 shares as the company’s stock declined 5.92% with the market. The institutional investor held 77,183 shares of the beverages (production and distribution) company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.54 million, down from 87,831 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Chatham Capital Group Inc who had been investing in Coca Cola Co for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $177.57B market cap company. The stock increased 0.02% or $0.01 during the last trading session, reaching $41.73. About 2.14M shares traded. The Coca-Cola Company (NYSE:KO) has risen 1.35% since May 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 10.20% the S&P500.
Verition Fund Management Llc decreased its stake in Avis Budget Group (CAR) by 77.15% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Verition Fund Management Llc sold 27,660 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.94% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 8,190 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $359,000, down from 35,850 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Verition Fund Management Llc who had been investing in Avis Budget Group for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $3.53B market cap company. The stock increased 0.81% or $0.35 during the last trading session, reaching $43.39. About 179,519 shares traded. Avis Budget Group, Inc. (NASDAQ:CAR) has risen 66.28% since May 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 54.73% the S&P500.
